signatures.description: Implement a real-time (Wing-Gong/Lowe) linearizability checker for concurrent read/write register histories. Input is an NDJSON event log with invoke/respond pairs, process ids, registers, and indeterminate pending operations; the checker must decide linearizability, honour happens-before order across processes while permitting overlap reordering, and emit a minimal failing prefix plus the violated edge when the history is not linearizable. Use memoised depth-first search with wing/pivot pruning rather than permutation enumeration, and keep per-register state separable.
